day5_start.name: Me
day5_start.text: *Sunday morning. Warm sunlight filters through the curtains.*

day5_morning_wake.name: Me
day5_morning_wake.text: *I opened my eyes. It's been a while since I woke up on my own without an alarm. The clock reads 8 AM.*

day5_morning_stretch.name: Me
day5_morning_stretch.text: *I stretch and stare at the ceiling. It doesn't feel real that today is Sunday.*

day5_morning_think.name: Me
day5_morning_think.text: *It's only been five days since I transferred to this school. It feels like it's been at least a month.*

day5_morning_mirror.name: Me
day5_morning_mirror.text: *I washed my face and stood in front of the mirror. The face staring back at me looks... different from before I transferred.*

day5_morning_mirror2.name: Me
day5_morning_mirror2.text: *So much happened over the past four days. A new class, new people... and some very special encounters.*

day5_morning_phone_check.name: Me
day5_morning_phone_check.text: *I picked up the phone from my bed. There are notifications on the screen.*

day5_couple_msg_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_couple_msg_seoyeon.text: "Good morning ☀️ The weather's amazing today! I bet the flowers in the school garden are blooming. Wanna go see them together?"

day5_couple_react_seoyeon.name: Me
day5_couple_react_seoyeon.text: *Reading Seoyeon's message makes me smile without even trying. Talking about flowers first thing in the morning—that's so like her.*

day5_couple_reply_seoyeon.name: Me
day5_couple_reply_seoyeon.text: (I replied, "Sounds great! Let's meet at the school front gate. There's a place I want to show you too 😊")

day5_couple_msg_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_couple_msg_yuna.text: "...You up? You're going to school today, right? ...I'll go too. Front gate. 10 o'clock."

day5_couple_react_yuna.name: Me
day5_couple_react_yuna.text: (Short and sweet, just like Yuna... But if you look closely, there's a hint of excitement in the words "I'll go too.")

day5_couple_reply_yuna.name: Me
day5_couple_reply_yuna.text: ("Yeah, I'll be there. Wait for me." I replied calmly, but my heart is racing.)

day5_couple_msg_dain.name: Dain
day5_couple_msg_dain.text: "Good morning!! ☀️🏐 Let's go to school today!! Meet me at the front gate!! I'll run over!! Don't you DARE be late!!!"

day5_couple_react_dain.name: Me
day5_couple_react_dain.text: *...So many exclamation marks. Dain's overflowing with energy from the crack of dawn. But somehow, messages like this give me energy too.*

day5_couple_reply_dain.name: Me
day5_couple_reply_dain.text: (I texted back, "Haha, got it! I won't be late. Don't run—be careful on your way!")

day5_couple_msg_nurse.name: School Nurse
day5_couple_msg_nurse.text: "Did you sleep well? The weather's so nice today, I'm feeling a little giddy. Want to meet in front of the school? ...Meeting on a weekend feels different, doesn't it? 💕"

day5_couple_react_nurse.name: Me
day5_couple_react_nurse.text: *My face turned red at the heart emoji she sent. Meeting outside of school definitely feels different.*

day5_couple_reply_nurse.name: Me
day5_couple_reply_nurse.text: ("Yes, I'm looking forward to it. Let's meet at the front gate at 10!" I started writing formally but... it felt a bit awkward.)

day5_couple_msg_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_couple_msg_teacher.text: "Are you coming to school today? It's the weekend, but... I have something to see you about. Front gate, 10 o'clock. You'll be in trouble if you're late."

day5_couple_react_teacher.name: Me
day5_couple_react_teacher.text: ("Something to see me about," she says. Playing it cool, but she's the one who reached out first. I like that about her.)

day5_couple_reply_teacher.name: Me
day5_couple_reply_teacher.text: (I texted back, "I won't be late. I'll definitely be there!" and let out a small smile.)

day5_pending_msg_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_pending_msg_seoyeon.text: "Are you free today? I need someone to help with the garden... Oh, no pressure though! 😅"

day5_pending_react_seoyeon.name: Me
day5_pending_react_seoyeon.text: (Seoyeon's asking me to come. She says "no pressure," but... I know I want to go.)

day5_pending_reply_seoyeon.name: Me
day5_pending_reply_seoyeon.text: (Today, I have to tell her how I feel. I replied, "I'll be there! Let's meet at the front gate.")

day5_pending_msg_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_pending_msg_yuna.text: "...School. Today. Can you come? ...I have something to tell you."

day5_pending_react_yuna.name: Me
day5_pending_react_yuna.text: ("I have something to tell you." My heart skipped a beat. Could Yuna also feel the same way about me...?)

day5_pending_reply_yuna.name: Me
day5_pending_reply_yuna.text: (I have something to say too. "Yeah, I'll be there." I replied briefly and set my phone down.)

day5_pending_msg_dain.name: Dain
day5_pending_msg_dain.text: "Hey! Wanna come to school today?! Do you have a sec after practice? It's important!!"

day5_pending_react_dain.name: Me
day5_pending_react_dain.text: (She said "it's important." Dain being serious is rare. I wonder what it could be.)

day5_pending_reply_dain.name: Me
day5_pending_reply_dain.text: (And I have something I need to say today too. I replied, "I'll be there!! Wait for me!")

day5_pending_msg_nurse.name: School Nurse
day5_pending_msg_nurse.text: "Are you coming to school today by any chance? I need to organize the nurse's office... It'd be nice if you could come help."

day5_pending_react_nurse.name: Me
day5_pending_react_nurse.text: *Organizing the nurse's office on a weekend... It sounds like an excuse, but if it means I can see her, the reason doesn't matter.*

day5_pending_reply_nurse.name: Me
day5_pending_reply_nurse.text: (Today, I have to tell her how I feel. I replied, "I'll be there! Let's meet at the front gate.")

day5_pending_msg_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_pending_msg_teacher.text: "Can you come by school today? I could use help organizing some paperwork. ...Don't get any ideas, there's no hidden meaning."

day5_pending_react_teacher.name: Me
day5_pending_react_teacher.text: ("No hidden meaning"—somehow that makes it feel even more meaningful. Could she be feeling the same way?)

day5_pending_reply_teacher.name: Me
day5_pending_reply_teacher.text: (If today passes, I might never get another chance. I texted back, "I'll be there!")

day5_default_msg_start.name: Me
day5_default_msg_start.text: *I turned on my phone... but there are no new messages.*

day5_default_msg_scroll.name: Me
day5_default_msg_scroll.text: *I scroll through my chat list. Conversations from the past few days stretch on and on.*

day5_default_msg_reflect.name: Me
day5_default_msg_reflect.text: *Since transferring, I've met so many people. Seoyeon, Yuna, Dain, the school nurse, the homeroom teacher...*

day5_default_msg_reflect2.name: Me
day5_default_msg_reflect2.text: *They were all so kind to me... but in the end, I never managed to properly tell any of them how I feel.*

day5_default_msg_resolve.name: Me
day5_default_msg_resolve.text: *...No, it's not over yet. Today is Sunday. If I go to school, maybe I'll run into someone.*

day5_default_msg_decide.name: Me
day5_default_msg_decide.text: *It's the last day. I'll at least take a walk around the school. Something might change.*

day5_morning_ready.name: Me
day5_morning_ready.text: *Time to get ready. I stood in front of my closet.*

day5_morning_closet.name: Me
day5_morning_closet.text: *It's Sunday, so I don't have to wear the school uniform... but what should I wear?*

day5_outfit_choice.name: Me
choices: A little dressed up *today's special, after all*

day5_outfit_casual.name: Me
day5_outfit_casual.text: *A crisp shirt and jeans. Comfortable yet neat. Yeah, keeping it natural is more my style.*

day5_outfit_special.name: Me
day5_outfit_special.text: *I picked my outfit more carefully than usual. One last check in the mirror. ...Looks good, I think.*

day5_breakfast.name: Me
day5_breakfast.text: *I made some quick toast and ate. A quiet kitchen on a Sunday morning. I can hear birds singing outside.*

day5_outfit_check.name: Me
day5_outfit_check.text: *One final look at myself in the mirror. My eyes are definitely different from the first day I transferred.*

day5_morning_items.name: Me
day5_morning_items.text: *Wallet, phone, keys. All set. I stood at the front door.*

day5_morning_depart.name: Me
day5_morning_depart.text: *I opened the door and stepped outside. A pleasant spring breeze greeted me.*

day5_walk_seoyeon_2.name: Me
day5_walk_seoyeon_2.text: *Seoyeon was already there at our meeting spot. Standing in the sunlight, she looked radiant.*

day5_walk_seoyeon_talk.name: Seoyeon
day5_walk_seoyeon_talk.text: "The weather's so nice today. Even nicer walking together. Did you know cherry blossoms bloom along this path in spring?"

day5_walk_seoyeon_react.name: Me
day5_walk_seoyeon_react.text: *I walked side by side with Seoyeon. Without saying a word, our steps naturally fell in sync.*

day5_walk_couple_yuna.name: Me
day5_walk_couple_yuna.text: *When I arrived at our meeting spot, Yuna was leaning against the wall. One earbud in her ear.*

day5_walk_yuna_talk.name: Me
day5_walk_yuna_talk.text: *Yuna pulled out one earbud and held it out to me. No words needed—she wanted me to listen along.*

day5_walk_yuna_react.name: Me
day5_walk_yuna_react.text: *We shared the earbuds and walked side by side. No words, but this silence isn't uncomfortable. If anything, it's nice.*

day5_walk_dain_2.name: Me
day5_walk_dain_2.text: *Dain was waving both arms from way over there. Where does she get all that energy this early in the morning?*

day5_walk_dain_talk.name: Dain
day5_walk_dain_talk.text: "Going to school on a Sunday is kinda weird, but since I'm with you, it feels like a field trip! Let's go, let's go!!"

day5_walk_dain_react.name: Me
day5_walk_dain_react.text: *I walked along, pulled by Dain's hand. Before I knew it, I was smiling too. Her energy must be contagious.*

day5_walk_couple_nurse.name: Me
day5_walk_couple_nurse.text: *When I arrived at the meeting spot, she was standing there in casual clothes. She looks so different from how she does at school.*

day5_walk_nurse_2.name: School Nurse
day5_walk_nurse_2.text: "You made it. Seeing you on the weekend feels different. You've only ever seen me in my lab coat, after all."

day5_walk_nurse_talk.name: School Nurse
day5_walk_nurse_talk.text: "If we go this way, it's a shortcut to school. ...It's also a path where nobody we know would see us."

day5_walk_nurse_react.name: Me
day5_walk_nurse_react.text: *The slightly shy look on her face was something new. Just walking side by side was enough to make my heart race.*

day5_walk_couple_teacher.name: Me
day5_walk_couple_teacher.text: *When I arrived at the meeting spot, she was standing in casual clothes. A far cry from the strict teacher I see in the classroom.*

day5_walk_teacher_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_walk_teacher_2.text: "I thought you'd be late, but you're right on time. ...That's a compliment, by the way."

day5_walk_teacher_talk.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_walk_teacher_talk.text: "This is the first time we've walked together on a weekend. ...It's different from school, isn't it? Right now, I'm not a teacher. I'm just... a person."

day5_walk_teacher_react.name: Me
day5_walk_teacher_react.text: ("Just a person." Those words made my chest feel warm. I've never seen her this honest before.)

day5_walk_couple_common.name: Me
day5_walk_couple_common.text: *Walking side by side, we talked about everything that happened the past few days. How we first met, the funny moments, the times our hearts raced.*

day5_walk_couple_common2.name: Me
day5_walk_couple_common2.text: *Before I knew it, the school came into view. I thought I'd dread saying goodbye, but today marks the beginning of a day we're spending together.*

day5_walk_pending_start.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_start.text: *I left the house and started walking toward school.*

day5_walk_pending_think.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_think.text: *I can't stop thinking about how I didn't confess yesterday. Today... today I absolutely will.*

day5_walk_pending_plan.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_plan.text: (What should I say? "I like you"? "Will you go out with me"? No, maybe I should just play it by ear...)

day5_walk_pending_nervous.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_nervous.text: *My hands are already trembling. With every step, my heart beats faster.*

day5_walk_pending_resolve.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_resolve.text: *It's okay. I have four days' worth of memories together. Those moments give me courage.*

day5_walk_pending_memory.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_memory.text: *The awkward greeting on the first day, laughing together at lunch, our after-school conversations... every moment was precious.*

day5_walk_pending_ready.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_ready.text: *Right. If I don't want any regrets, I have to say it today.*

day5_walk_pending_almost.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_almost.text: *The school is just up ahead. I took one deep breath.*

day5_walk_default_start.name: Me
day5_walk_default_start.text: *Walking alone on a Sunday morning. Normally, I'd still be in bed at this hour.*

day5_walk_default_reflect.name: Me
day5_walk_default_reflect.text: *Before I transferred, my Sunday mornings were nothing but lounging around at home.*

day5_walk_default_change.name: Me
day5_walk_default_change.text: *But now things have changed. I never thought the day would come when I'd actually want to go to school on a Sunday.*

day5_walk_default_people.name: Me
day5_walk_default_people.text: *Seoyeon's warmth, Yuna's mysteriousness, Dain's brightness, the school nurse's gentleness, the homeroom teacher's sincerity... They were all meaningful connections.*

day5_walk_default_arrive.name: Me
day5_walk_default_arrive.text: *The school building comes into view up ahead. The same scenery I saw on my very first day here.*

day5_arrive_start.name: Me
day5_arrive_start.text: *I stood in front of the school gate.*

day5_arrive_nostalgia.name: Me
day5_arrive_nostalgia.text: *This gate... Five days ago, when I first came to this school, I stood in this exact spot.*

day5_arrive_firstday.name: Me
day5_arrive_firstday.text: *Back then, everything was unfamiliar. A new school, a new classroom, faces I didn't recognize. I was so nervous my feet wouldn't move.*

day5_arrive_now.name: Me
day5_arrive_now.text: *Now it's different. There are people I know here, and a place I can come back to. I walked past the gate and headed inside.*
